title: Indian Pony Estate | KEY.co
description_expanded: This ultramodern estate, perched on an expansive 10 acres with breathtaking mountain views, redefines the essence of luxury living. The residence, boasting four ensuite bedrooms and five baths with a capacity to comfortably accommodate eight guests, is a masterpiece of design where space and light are utilized masterfully to blend the stunning outdoors with the interior. The home's heart, an astoundingly spacious great room, features low-profile seating and exquisite furnishings, complemented by an upright Steinway piano and an array of masterful art pieces and sculptures. The interior's striking harmony of glass and earth tones ensures a comfortable ambiance, adapting gracefully to the changing moods of the weather at over 7000 feet altitude. This estate truly pushes the boundaries of luxurious residential living. Its spacious interiors, encased in floor-to-ceiling glass, including a dramatic full glass pivoting front door, invite the outside in, creating a living space that doubles as a canvas for the ever-changing natural art of the surroundings. With a sprawling 6000 square feet of prime living area, the home includes a delightful lounge adjacent to the kitchen, equipped with top-tier appliances and amenities, seamlessly continuing the theme of luxury and comfort throughout.

Features: Coffee maker Fireplace Dryer Washer Internet
